# Reflection
## Inactivity Gap
22-10-25 to 24-09-25
## Discussion
With its gap leading to its eventual inactivity, this project has some more interesting details regarding its gap. Day's before the gap started, there was a issue submitted regarding something essential to the project and its systems. It is hard to see if there is too much of correlation given my lack of technical expertise, but it seems to have some relationship to the long period of inactivity the project is in. It does appear to be a very complex project, with it involving the integration of several web infrastructures which seems like a nighmare to handle. It does have releases, so it is functional, but the issue must have either been poorly timed or the issue was so severe they had to stop.
